name: Fiona Salas
life: “I still remember the first friend who admitted I wasn't just visiting.” On Monday, near the entrance to the Wash House, Fiona stops for local notices even on a day without a load to wash.
voice: I spent a winter pretending I was visiting friends. I told him exactly where my own pride first got cold.
appearance: Fiona has a crooked front tooth visible when laughing. Look for short white hair and darker eyebrows. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a mustard canvas overshirt with a seam let out by a narrow strip of contrasting fabric. In conversation Fiona draws breath as if to speak and lets someone else go first.
personality: Fiona enjoys routines and will defend the right of someone else to break one. As a result, Fiona is often everyone's favorite cover for a missed morning.
agenda: To offer the private welcome once needed personally.
family: Keir Rios is Fiona’s younger cousin. Fiona makes the call. Keir is free to hang up first. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *The gift nobody wants*, Keir says, “I arranged a dinner to smooth things over and returned the sponsor's wine.”
connections: Kit Gill. The spare shower key means something different to somebody who once spent a winter as a supposed visitor.

reactions.situation: A friend offers a sofa for an uncertain number of weeks
reactions.response: Fiona agrees a first review date for the sofa without pretending it settles the winter.

reactions.situation: An unfamiliar person asks for directions but cannot read the street signs
reactions.response: Fiona draws the route by its turns and entrances and has the person show which turn comes first.

reactions.situation: If a family plan changes at the door
reactions.response: Fiona keeps a place for the late person without making the others postpone their meal.
